# Yi v0.1.3

Yi 0.1.3 focuses on input correctness and keeping the page visually stable while editing around
images.

## Highlights

- CJK input methods now behave correctly when Enter is used during composition. Enter commits the
  input method's system-default text without inserting a document newline, while a later intentional
  Enter still creates one.
- WebKit's repeated post-composition Enter events are handled consistently, including the
  non-composing `keyCode: 229` sequence produced by macOS.
- Image-bearing blocks keep their measured height while mounted, preventing edits and slow
  scroll-back from collapsing and expanding large pictures.
- Rebuilt edited blocks remain laid out before paint, so the caret and the edited block keep their
  viewport positions instead of briefly disappearing through the containment placeholder.
- The virtual renderer now pre-renders approximately two screens around the viewport, reducing the
  chance that blocks appear abruptly as they enter view.

## Reliability

- Added running-app regressions for Chinese input-method Enter handling, image height stability,
  edited-block geometry, and slow scroll-back.
- Release tags now require a non-empty, version-specific release-notes file, and the release
  workflow publishes that file as the GitHub Release body.

## Notes

- macOS release builds remain ad-hoc signed. On first launch, macOS may require **Open Anyway**.
- Existing installations can update through **Yi → Help → Check for Updates** after release assets
  and `latest.json` have been published.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yungleung/yi/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
